name: Text RPG Simulator
description: D&D-inspired interactive narrative RPG engine for Chattree. Features AI-generated 3-story openings, predefined Knight and Archer character selection in Flutter UI, 3-slot persistent campaigns, compact live campaign memory, and tension-driven d20 narrative pacing.
author: Chattree Core Team
changelog: 2.0.0: Added 3-slot persistent campaigns (/rpg games, /rpg switch), AI-generated 3-story opening selection in Flutter UI, predefined Knight/Archer ASCII symbol art selection, live compact campaign summary memory, tension + d20 D&D narrative pacing, and two-step /rpg delete confirmation.

tools.description: D&D-inspired narrative RPG engine. If the active slot is empty or the user runs /rpg new, generate 3 distinct short story premises (s1_title, s1_premise, s2_title, s2_premise, s3_title, s3_premise) and call action='new'. When [RPG_STATE] is returned, narrate immersively in the user's language with rich sensory detail and clear narrative momentum (avoid repetitive 'What do you do?' endings and avoid filler combat). Respect the engine's phase (OPENING, EXPLORATION, SKILL_CHECK, COMBAT_AMBUSH, COMBAT_ROUND, COMBAT_VICTORY, CAMP_REST, GAME_OVER), d20 roll, tension, and HP. On every 'action' turn, provide a short summary_note (1-2 concise sentences) and tension_delta so the engine preserves long-term campaign memory.

intentContract.description: Manages campaigns, 3-story openings, Knight/Archer class selection, D&D turn resolution, and save slots.

fields.name: query
fields.description: Player intent, story number (1-3), class ('knight'|'archer'), or slot number (1-3).

fields.name: intent
fields.description: Natural language player action for 'action' turns.

fields.name: s1_premise
fields.description: AI-generated Story 1 short premise for action='new'.

fields.name: s2_premise
fields.description: AI-generated Story 2 short premise for action='new'.

fields.name: s3_premise
fields.description: AI-generated Story 3 short premise for action='new'.

fields.name: summary_note
fields.description: Concise 1-sentence event/location update appended to the persistent campaign summary.

fields.name: tension_delta
fields.description: Tension adjustment (-40 to +40) based on danger/pacing.

fields.name: roll_needed
fields.description: True if the action requires a d20 skill or attack check.

fields.name: dc
fields.description: Difficulty Class (5-20) when roll_needed is true.

fields.name: combat_outcome
fields.description: Set to 'victory' when an active combat encounter is resolved.

fields.name: rest
fields.description: True when the party rests/camps to recover HP and lower tension.

examples.input: I examine the cracked altar for hidden runes

output.intent: examine the cracked altar for hidden runes
output.summary_note: Inspected the cracked altar for hidden runes.
